thread:
jess_support: FYI customer CloudPilot says their org shows 0 tokens on the Console for 2026-02-14 but the CSV export contains ~18k token rows. Can someone look?

matt_billing: Can you paste the first 5 CSV lines and the org id?

jess_support: org=org-cloudpilot-9, export_id=exp-20260214-7, sample CSV lines:
```
org_id,day,model,tokens
org-cloudpilot-9,2026-02-14,gpt-3.5,1250
org-cloudpilot-9,2026-02-14,gpt-4,16750
org-cloudpilot-9,2026-02-14,gpt-3.5,300
```

sara_metrics: Ok that looks like raw event rows. Which Console view did they check? Daily rolling summary or hourly?

jess_support: They checked Billing > Usage (daily); console shows 0 for 2026-02-14 under Tokens used. They attached a screenshot (not here).

matt_billing: Quick theory: CSV path is the raw-export stream (raw_events), Console uses the daily_aggregates table. If aggregation job skipped that org/day, UI could show 0 while raw export still has rows. Did the agg job log any errors around Feb 14?

export_bot: agg-job-processor reported: WARN shard-7: out-of-order event detected, dropping batch for day=2026-02-14 at 2026-02-15T02:12:34Z.

eng_oncall: That's interesting — dropping batches shouldn't zero out the whole day unless the reduce step collapsed earlier partials. Can you run a quick count on daily_aggregates?

sara_metrics: Running query now:
```
SELECT sum(tokens) FROM daily_aggregates WHERE org_id='org-cloudpilot-9' AND day='2026-02-14';
```
returns 0.

sara_metrics: And raw_events count:
```
SELECT sum(tokens) FROM raw_events WHERE org_id='org-cloudpilot-9' AND DATE(ts)='2026-02-14';
```
returns 18750.

matt_billing: So agg pipeline missed aggregating those raw events. Any backlog or compaction around that time?

eng_oncall: Checking job timeline: on 2026-02-15 02:10 UTC the compactor ran a dedupe pass that de-duplicated by (org, day, model) using the first seen shard. There was a race where a late-shard wrote events with timestamps that normalized to 2026-02-14 after compaction — compactor kept the empty first shard and removed the shard with payload. Result: daily_aggregates never received that day's sum.

sara_metrics: Repro steps I used locally: 1) re-run compaction on raw shard files with --dry-run, 2) simulate late-shard insertion that retro-dates rows to previous day, 3) run aggregator. Aggregator ignores shards flagged as compacted -> sums to 0.

jess_support: So customer sees raw CSV (which is from raw_events S3 path) and gets tokens, but Console uses daily_aggregates which ended up 0. Billing system pulls from daily_aggregates for invoice preview?

matt_billing: Invoices use billing_rollups which are derived from daily_aggregates, yes. This explains why their invoice preview would show 0 for that day. Need short-term fix and a backfill.

eng_oncall: Action plan: 1) re-run compactor with safe-merge mode to restore the removed shard contents into a new compacted shard (ENG-1278) 2) re-run aggregator for org-cloudpilot-9 day=2026-02-14 3) trigger billing_rollup recompute for affected invoice window. I'll open an infra ticket and queue the jobs.

eng_oncall: I've opened infra ticket INF-4512 and kicked off a recompact job against S3 path s3://redwood-raw-exports/2026/02/14/shard-*/. ETA for compaction/resubmission: ~2 hours.

sara_metrics: Once compaction completes I'll run:
```
python tools/aggregate_day.py --org org-cloudpilot-9 --day 2026-02-14 --source s3
```
then validate:
```
SELECT sum(tokens) FROM daily_aggregates WHERE org_id='org-cloudpilot-9' AND day='2026-02-14';
```
should be 18750.

jess_support: I'll update the customer with the interim note: we found a processing bug that skipped their daily aggregation and we're backfilling; will follow up when invoice preview is updated.

matt_billing: Also flagging billing impact: if rollup changes, we need to create an invoice adjustment for the customer's Feb invoice if already finalized. Finance FYI.

eng_oncall: Update: compaction job finished at 1945681200, aggregator queued. Next update when aggregator done.

export_bot: aggregator-job-queue: job-778 enqueued for org-cloudpilot-9 day=2026-02-14.

sara_metrics: Aggregator finished at 1945682000. Validation query now returns 18750.

jess_support: Thanks team — I'll tell CloudPilot their usage will now show correctly and billing team will patch invoice if needed.

matt_billing: Please cc me when you message finance. I'll prepare a draft credit memo if invoice already closed.

jess_support: Will do. Closing loop once finance confirms. :thumbsup:
